name: mcpr-mcp-runner
stderr:
mcpr <command> [options]

Commands:
  mcpr init             Create a new mcp.config.json (interactive wizard)
  mcpr server <action>  Manage MCP servers (add | remove | list | info | start | stop | restart |
                        health | logs)
  mcpr tools [action]   Manage and call MCP tools
  mcpr config <action>  Manage mcpr configuration (show | path | validate | set)
  mcpr status           Server overview (config-only by default; use --name for live status)
  mcpr ping [name]      Health check one or all servers (exit 0 = healthy)
  mcpr run [name]       Start server(s) and keep them running (watch mode)
  mcpr doctor           Check system requirements and configuration health

Options:
      --json     Output as JSON                                           [boolean] [default: false]
      --global   Use ~/.mcp/mcp.config.json                               [boolean] [default: false]
  -h, --help     Show help                                                                 [boolean]
  -v, --version  Show version number                                                       [boolean]

Examples:
  mcpr init                                           Create mcp.config.json interactively
  mcpr server add                                     Add a new MCP server
  mcpr tools                                          List all available tools
  mcpr tools call --tool filesystem.read_file         Call a tool
  --input '{"path":"./README.md"}'
  mcpr status                                         Show server health overview
  mcpr ping filesystem                                Health-check one server
  mcpr doctor                                         Check system requirements

Please specify a command. Run "mcpr --help" for usage.
